PLAN "12-week Integrated Strength, Cardio, Nutrition & Recovery for Return to Skiing"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

  GOAL nutrition_maintenance:
    name "Maintain weight with supportive macro distribution"
  GOAL low_impact_cardio:
